worldcombat.skill.flash.summary: The user flares a bright light from its own body, dazzling everyone who can see it: their accuracy drops and their blows weaken. Light does not travel, so footwork cannot dodge it, but walls stop it.
worldcombat.skill.flash.use.0: Dazzle a whole ring of foes while surrounded
worldcombat.skill.flash.use.1: Cut the accuracy of a group in the open
worldcombat.skill.flash.use.2: Buy the team one safe damage window
worldcombat.skill.flash.description.0: A dazzled target strikes weaker, and a Pokemon also loses %1$s accuracy stage(s), for %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.flash.description.1: Centred on the user with a %1$s block radius; those caught keep about %2$s afterimage points. Closer targets are dazzled deeper, distant ones only lose one stage.
worldcombat.skill.flash.description.2: Gathering the light takes %1$s with a %2$s cooldown. Walls, pillars and other cover block the flash, so hiding behind cover avoids it.
worldcombat.skill.flash.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
Scatter: radius x1.35 catches more foes but each loses only the base stages; Focus: radius x0.75 covers less but adds one stage and x1.2 dazzle duration. Wind-up and cooldown shift with the form too.
worldcombat.skill.flash.preference.ai.ma: The companion only considers the flash while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it for point-blank crowds, larger charges in to flare.
worldcombat.skill.flash.preference.ai.de: It holds the flash until this many visible enemies stand in the radius; set 1 to flare at any sighting.
worldcombat.skill.flash.preference.ai.le: When on, the companion may leave its post to flare under a Hold order.
